name: memhop-guide
summary: MemHop memory-loop overview: Search (recall), Update (write-back) and Dream (consolidation, on its own schedule) run automatically on the host — the LLM must NOT call them manually; the abilities an LLM may call are the six cards indexed in resources; to use a card, resolve its 16-char hex capability id from the host card index (ListCapabilities projection carries id alongside name) and fetch the full parameter schema with GetCapability(id)
trigger: using the memhop memory system, unsure what is callable or which card fits the task; guide overview memory loop entry index

resources.name: memhop-knowledge
resources.desc: L3 knowledge graph: import/query entities and relations, expand subgraphs (use for durable facts, people, projects)

resources.name: memhop-scene
resources.desc: L2 scene management: list scenes, read topic context, merge scenes, delete wrong memories (memory correction)

resources.name: memhop-archive
resources.desc: L4 archive: search historical conversation text by keyword / time range / IDs (look up past raw messages)

resources.name: memhop-profile
resources.desc: L0 profile: read/update the host identity profile (use when the user actively corrects their profile)

resources.name: memhop-trajectory
resources.desc: L6 trajectory: append events for important operations (tool calls, subtasks, key decisions), read, stats

resources.name: memhop-capability
resources.desc: L5 capability loop: crystallize reusable abilities from trajectories, import external capabilities, activate/feedback/list/get-detail
